description: Beyond the op-v6s.15.9 halo-exchange first slice: distribute the global linear solve across ranks -- distributed matrix-vector products + a parallel Krylov method (all_reduce for dot products), plus multi-dimensional / unstructured domain partitioning. Uses outram-park-mpi collectives.
title: pflotran: fully MPI-parallel implicit solve (distributed Jacobian + Krylov)
